data.exact_reserve_text: Claims incurred, net of reinsurance, totalled GBP 448.0 million during the calendar year (2015: GBP 308.2 million). This includes an amount of GBP 33.1 million in respect of increases to reserves on 2014 and prior underwriting years (2015: GBP 33.6 million in respect of reserve releases from 2013 and prior underwriting years).

prior_year_events.impact_description: The revised Ogden rate of minus 0.75% has resulted in an increase to our combined ratio from 99.8% to 107.7% and a material impact to the result of the Syndicate, particularly on the 2014 year of account result, leading to an increase in reserves for bodily injury claims.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a prior year strengthening of GBP 33.1 million in 2016, primarily driven by the change in the Ogden discount rate for bodily injury claims, which significantly impacted the 2014 and prior underwriting years. Additionally, a loss of GBP 15.7 million was incurred from business inherited through the reinsurance to close of the 2013 year of account. The year also saw an increased prevalence of smaller-scale natural disasters, such as Hurricane Matthew, contributing to the adverse development.
